# BioPlausibleDisturbanceEstimation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A method of estimating external perturbations using spiking neural networks that mimic cerebellar or cortical predictive coding mechanisms. It bridges neuroscience-inspired computation with engineering control, enabling energy-efficient and real-time disturbance rejection in neuromorphic hardware.
